Definition: to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; in transitively, to graze (literally or figuratively); generally to rule; by extension, to associate with (as a friend)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to pasture, tend, graze, feed; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to tend, pasture; 1a1a) to shepherd; 1a1b) of ruler, teacher (fig); 1a1c) of people as flock (fig); 1a1d) shepherd, herdsman (subst); 1a2) to feed, graze; 1a2a) of cows, sheep etc (literal); 1a2b) of idolater, Israel as flock (fig); 1b) (Hiphil) shepherd, shepherdess; 2) to associate with, be a friend of (meaning probable); 2a) (Qal) to associate with; 2b) (Hithpael) to be companions; 3) (Piel) to be a special friend
